svg.aria-label: Avishek Mishra. Make it work. Make it scale. Full stack, cloud and product. 15 projects shipped: 8 web, 3 mobile, 2 Shopify, 1 IoT, 1 AI and ML. Stack across web, mobile, cloud, data and AI. Selected work: Pabitra Electricals system, Tekkzy Fit, Crusher Management System, electricity billing software, TekkzyWork.

g.text: owner of products, end to end
I take a product from design to deployment, then keep it fast when real people use it.
Runs day-to-day operations for a team of 20–30. My largest and most complex build.
Hard part: Requirements changed mid-build, so the database was restructured several times. I trimmed the API schema
so responses carry only what the frontend needs.
Gym desk app linked to a face-attendance terminal, with a
staff web desk and cloud APIs.
Hard part: The phone finds the terminal on gym Wi-Fi by itself, queues
punches offline, and syncs when staff reconnect.
Tracks material production, expenses, sales and machines.
Hard part: Delivered end to end in 5 days, tuned to respond at 0.1
Mbps. The client then referred Pabitra Electricals.
Billing software for a live client.
